incidents-bot: [INCIDENT] High 5xx spike - embeddings-service (us-west2) — pages sent to #eng-oncall. p95 latency doubled, errors >20% last 5m. Pager: https://pager.redwood/INC-2026-0423

Sam: I'm primary for next hour. On it. Starting quick triage.

Priya: I'm secondary, available for escalation. - checking dashboards now

Sam: Observed: embedding nodes 3/12 reporting OOM evictions and 503 downstream. Autoscaler is in cool-down. Looks correlated w/ a traffic spike from large-batch customer.

Jorge: Logs show OOMs around 14:05 UTC, kernel messages attached:
```
OOM kill process 32789 (kv-cache) total-vm: ...
traceback: ...
```

Leah: Customer ops flagged increased error rate for ClientA — they're seeing 50% failures for batch jobs. Pinged account team.

Sam: Mitigation plan: 1) Scale up reserved pool (hot) 2) Rollback last config change that increased max batch size 3) Enable fallback model-route to lower-memory model.

Priya: I'm scaling dedicated pool now:
`redwoodctl scale --pool embeddings-usw --add-gpus 4`
ETA ~3m

incidents-bot: ACTION LOG - scale started by Priya at 9991112300

Sam: Rolling back config in k8s: applied patch to revert batch-size to 128 -> 64. Patch snippet:
```
- max_batch_size: 128
+ max_batch_size: 64
```
Applied and restarting injector pods.

Jorge: Observability: kv-cache hit-rate unchanged, but eviction rate falling after scale. 5xx rate decreased from 22% -> 6% over 7m.

Leah: Confirmed ClientA reports drop to ~7% failures. Account team notified. :thumbsup:

Sam: Next steps: keep pool at +4 until traffic stabilizes for another 30m, monitor OOMs, follow up with infra to inspect node memory config. Owner: Sam. Secondary: Priya.

Priya: Putting runbook link in thread: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-oom-mitigation — notes on fallback routes and scaling.

Jorge: Postmortem checklist added to backlog. Suggest we add an automated guard to limit max_batch_size for self-serve customers.

Sam: Handoff to morning shift @Jules (oncall) at 9991113250. I'll leave the pool scaled and link to current graphs: https://kibana.redwood/embeddings/9991112223

Jules: (incoming) Thanks Sam, I will watch for the next 60m. Primary/secondary acknowledged.

incidents-bot: Thread closed for handoff. Incident severity downgraded to sev3, customer impact contained. Last update 9991113250
